blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Willoughby Guide

items.t: Willoughby guide is a Township of Langley neighbourhood guide headed "Willoughby Heights, Langley Guide | Homes, Schools & Plans," written October 8, 2026, with a "Homes for sale in Willoughby Heights" section described as "Live MLS® listings, updated daily"; the page displays no total result count, and the cards visible at reading are a snapshot only.

Identity: the guide covers the board sub-area "Willoughby Heights" in the Township of Langley — every card visible on the guide page is labelled "Willoughby Heights, Langley." The Township's official planning name for the area is "Willoughby"; "Willoughby Heights" is the name the board's data uses for this sub-area.

Boundaries (planning, not board): per the Willoughby Community Plan Area description in Bylaw No. 6201, the plan area is bordered by the municipal boundary with the City of Surrey to the southwest, Highway 1 to the north, the ridgeline of the Trans Mountain Pipeline right-of-way and Lower Mainland Regional Park and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east; the guide page states the same boundary set in its own words. The exact board sub-area boundary versus that plan-area boundary: Not verified.
Nearby areas: Walnut Grove to the north across Highway 1, Langley City and Murrayville to the south, Brookswood to the southeast, Clayton Heights (Surrey) to the southwest.

Schools (Ministry-listed names ONLY), SD35, physically in Willoughby and named on the guide page: Willoughby Elementary, 20766 80 Ave; Lynn Fripps Elementary, 21020 83 Ave; Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 20965 77a Ave; Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, 7844 204B St; Josette Dandurand Elementary, 20143 82 Ave; Yorkson Creek Middle School, 20686 84 Ave; Peter Ewart Middle School, 7755 202A St; R.E. Mountain Secondary, 7633 202A St. Settled locator chain (sample-address only, non-transferable): for 7888 200 Street, the SD35 School Locator returns Elementary — Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary; Middle — Peter Ewart Middle School; Secondary — R.E. Mountain Secondary. Catchments for any other Willoughby address, and the guide page's claim that new Willoughby Slope catchments take effect in September 2027: Not verified.
Hubs: Langley Events Centre, 7888 200 Street — a Township-owned multi-purpose sports and events facility, with Willoughby Community Park beside it; Muriel Arnason Library is at 130 - 20338 65 Avenue.
Transit: TransLink route 501 runs Surrey Central Station to Langley Centre via Fraser Highway and 200 Street, cited to the route 501 timetable document.
How people search for it: "Willoughby," "Willoughby Heights," "Yorkson," "Latimer Heights," and by the hub landmarks — Langley Events Centre, Carvolth Exchange and Willoughby Town Centre.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Willoughby
What a duplex looks like in Willoughby

items.t: The usual duplex form: Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, s.403 (Residential Compact Lot Zone R-CL) — minimum lot area 220 m², maximum lot area 464.5 m², minimum lot frontage 11 m (front-loaded) / 8.2 m (rear-loaded).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Willoughby

items.t: Zoning, SSMUH and suites (Township): SSMUH Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) allows 3 units on eligible lots of 280 m² or smaller and 4 units on larger eligible lots up to 4,050 m²; lots over 4,050 m² are ineligible, and no 6-unit tier applies in the Township — duplexes are the baseline SSMUH form. A coach house is a fee-simple second unit under s.102, never strata. Servicing Bylaw 2019 No. 5382 is confirmed.

faq.q: Is Willoughby the same as Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: The Township's planning name is Willoughby; the board's sub-area name — the name on every card on the guide page — is Willoughby Heights.

faq.q: What are the compact-lot rules in Willoughby?
faq.a: Under Bylaw 2500 s.403 (R-CL): minimum lot area 220 m², maximum LOT area 464.5 m², frontages 11 m front-loaded / 8.2 m rear-loaded — the pattern changes garage, parking and lane expectations, and there is no 355 m² figure in the bylaw.

faq.q: How did Willoughby Heights sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached 100 / 13 / 13%; Condos & Townhomes 369 / 70 / 19% — the largest attached inventory and sales count in Langley. No Willoughby-only median is published; combined-Langley medians blend in the City of Langley and are context only; land has no SnapStats category.

faq.q: Which school serves a Willoughby lot?
faq.a: Only one address is settled: 7888 200 Street → Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary / Peter Ewart Middle / R.E. Mountain Secondary (single-address only). Every other address is not verified — run the exact address in the SD35 School Locator.

faq.q: How much PTT on a $1.2M Willoughby lot?
Are the Westbrooke duplexes a separate duplex project?
faq.a: Fee-simple means no strata, no Form B, no strata fees — diligence is title, Township rules and any registered covenants.

faq.q: Did the 2026 Willoughby plan update already change what can be built beside me?
faq.a: The guide page's June 15, 2026 adoption framing is not verified and is not followed here — check the Township's update page for the bylaws' live stage.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Willoughby address?
faq.a: Mountain Secondary. It applies to that address only; every other address is not verified until run. The guide page's claim that new Willoughby Slope catchments take effect in September 2027 is not verified.

faq.q: Which schools are in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: The guide page names Willoughby, Lynn Fripps, Richard Bulpitt, Donna Gabriel Robins and Josette Dandurand elementaries, Yorkson Creek and Peter Ewart middle schools, and R.E. Mountain Secondary — all confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file by name and address. Catchments are set by address; the recorded locator run for 7888 200 Street returns Donna Gabriel Robins, Peter Ewart and R.E. Mountain (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What changed in the 2026 Willoughby Community Plan?
faq.a: Council adopted an updated Willoughby Community Plan (Bylaw 6201), the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan (6202) and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan (6203) on June 15, 2026, per the guide page, repealing several older neighbourhood plans.
